title: Jubilant Flaky Russian Beef Dumplings
description: A paleo-friendly Russian dish featuring fermented dough and beef filling with fennel seeds, mantecare-emulsify gives it a rich flavor, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Combine ground beef, chopped onion, fennel seeds, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together almond flour and eggs to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the dumplings for 5 minutes on each side.
Add water to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite toppings.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
